blocks.text: Central Park Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Central Park itself is the boundary anchor: the City of Burnaby film kit describes an 86-hectare park at 3883 Imperial Street, in the Metrotown area.
The houses in this page sit on the streets around the park, including Patterson Avenue on its east side, where the City's Central Spark event runs from Kingsway to Central Boulevard.

blocks.text: Central Park Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The house stock here is defined by what it faces: detached-house streets on the park's east and south edges along Patterson Avenue and Imperial Street, not the park land itself, which is City park.
Kingsway, the north edge, is the corridor street: houses do not front the park on that side; the park's main stadium entrance is off Kingsway, east of Boundary Road.

blocks.text: Central Park Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The park-specific rule that affects these houses is event control: for the City's Central Spark event, parking restrictions applied on Patterson Avenue from Kingsway to Central Boulevard and on Central Boulevard from Patterson Avenue to Wilson Avenue, with vehicles required off those streets by 11:59 p.m. on October 29, 2026.

blocks.text: Central Park Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: A perimeter trail circles the park: the City's 2018 annual report records the first phase of an accessible four-metre-wide, multi-use Central Park Perimeter Trail along Boundary Road to Imperial Street.
Central Park Outdoor Pool and Swangard Stadium both hold City-placed nasal naloxone kits inside their automated external defibrillator cases, part of a pilot the City launched in 2020.
There is no smoking in Burnaby parks: the City states Central Spark is non-smoking and that no smoking is allowed in Burnaby parks, with no designated smoking areas at the event.
The park's pitch-and-putt parking and lower pond are reached from Imperial Street, on the houses' side of the park.
Patterson Station is the rapid-transit stop: TransLink's system map shows Patterson on the Expo Line in Burnaby, between Joyce–Collingwood and Metrotown stations.

blocks.text: Central Park Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check event exposure, not just zoning: houses on Patterson Avenue and Central Boulevard sit inside the road-closure and parking-restriction area the City publishes for Central Park events, so confirm the current event calendar before assuming unrestricted street parking.

blocks.text: Central Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

10 houses sold in Central Park with a median price of $1,925,500 (the middle half sold between $1,617,000 and $2,200,000), taking a median of 14 days to sell at 91.3% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $808 per square foot, a median year built of 1954 and a median lot of 7,096 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central Park?
faq.a: 9, in the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® month-end figures for October 2026. Listings change every day; Jared can tell you what is available now.

faq.q: Is Central Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Central Park had a sales ratio of 11% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Central Park accounted for 7 of the 251 houses sold across Burnaby from June to October 2026.

faq.q: What is actually inside Central Park?
faq.a: Central Park is an 86-hectare City park with a lake, Douglas fir, cedar and vine maple trees, tennis courts, an outdoor swimming pool, a horseshoe pitch, a playground, a spray park and a pitch-and-putt golf course, listed in the City of Burnaby's own film kit at 3883 Imperial Street. The pitch-and-putt is a City golf facility at the same Imperial Street address.

faq.q: What is Swangard Stadium used for now?
faq.a: Swangard Stadium, at Central Park's northwest corner, is a City venue booked for sporting, cultural, corporate and fundraising events, and the City's Canada Day StreetFest puts its mainstage acts in Central Park beside it. The City also lists designated parking for permit holders at the main stadium parking lot, reached eastbound on Kingsway east of Boundary Road, during major park events.

faq.q: Which SkyTrain station serves these houses?
faq.a: Patterson Station, on the Expo Line at Patterson Avenue and Central Boulevard, is the station at the park's northeast corner, and Metrotown Station is the next station east. The City directs festival visitors to both stations and closes parts of Patterson Avenue and Central Boulevard for its Central Park events, so station-adjacent houses also carry event-day road closures.

faq.q: Does the Kingsway corridor change daily life on these streets?
faq.a: Yes, on event days most of all. Kingsway is the park's north frontage and the Metrotown shopping district's main street, and the City's event pages show road closures and parking restrictions on Patterson Avenue and Central Boulevard for park events, with a bike valet at the tennis courts at Patterson and Mayberry during StreetFest.

faq.q: What did houses in Central Park sell for?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Central Park from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $1,925,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Central Park?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 14 days. At the median, sale prices were 91.3% of list, and 10% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
